purpose: Phase C0 (Browser Oracle Freeze) for Logic Matrix MCP x DSRS. A fixed golden query set, captured by running the REAL production browser query-encoder code path (same CDN URL, same model call, same pooling/normalize, same live-fetched query_instruction as shell/public/semantic/semantic-vector.js), not a reimplementation. This is the reference every future server-side encoder gets compared against in Phase C1.

files.browser-q8-oracle-2026-08-15.json: full capture: 30 queries, each with the complete 512-dim float32 vector, L2 norm, and SHA-256 of the raw vector bytes. ~484KB, committed (not regenerable in the same sense as scripts/export_vectorize.py's output -- this is a snapshot of what the LIVE CDN-served model actually produced at this moment, not a deterministic function of already-committed source data, so it can't just be regenerated later and trusted to match).
files.browser-q8-oracle-2026-08-15.summary.jso: same metadata + per-query {query, dim, l2_norm, sha256} WITHOUT the 512-dim vectors themselves -- for quick human/AI reading without pulling ~450KB of floats into context.

capture_method: Browser pane (mcp__Claude_Browser__javascript_tool) executed on the LIVE site https://unboundedaxiom.org, dynamic-importing the exact same jsDelivr URL (@huggingface/transformers@4.2.0/+esm) and calling pipeline("feature-extraction", "Xenova/bge-small-zh-v1.5", {dtype:"q8"}) then model(query_instruction + query, {pooling:"mean", normalize:true}) -- byte-for-byte the same call shell/public/semantic/semantic-vector.js's semanticScores() makes, not a hand-written approximation. query_instruction was live-fetched from /ai/semantic-vectors-meta.json rather than hardcoded, matching production.
golden_set_design: 30 queries covering every category the Phase C handoff specified: exact corpus terms (動態不動點/全域量詞/AICL/DSRS), a direct paper-id lookup (lm-001862, lm-000001), rare-but-real corpus terms confirmed present via grep before inclusion (W-20: 3 files, CASP: 1 file), English (Navier-Stokes/Riemann Hypothesis/quantum entanglement/personal identity over time/MCP/best pizza recipe), zh-en mixed (DSRS 的 hybrid retrieval 設計), math symbols ($P=NP$, quantifier notation), deliberately off-topic controls (coffee, Taipei weather, pizza -- expected near-floor scores), and zero-lexical-overlap natural-language paraphrases (a full-sentence Ship-of-Theseus question using none of the corpus's own terminology, and a paraphrase of 'independently_convergent' avoiding that exact phrase).
